label: Jul 1 – 30, 2026 (Full Month)
period_mismatch_note: Both windows are 30 days, but they overlap by 27 days (Jul 1 – 27), so period-over-period deltas are heavily damped. The more meaningful movement is the dashboard-native month-over-month deltas (July vs June), quoted where available: users +92.7%, calls +88.9%, organic impressions +12.2%.
cadence_note: Full-calendar-month report for July, generated alongside the Jul 16–30 fortnight snapshot (2026-07-30) that was produced for the client review. Both cover activity ending Jul 30.

summary.narrative: July closed as the strongest month of the year: $21.1K in paid media produced 107 leads at a blended $197 each, holding June-July's record pace at the best unit economics to date. Meta delivered 78 leads at $116 and Google search converted 28 leads at a 1.48% search-only rate — its best reading this year — with Branded Search at $54 per conversion. The phone recovered without fully healing: 17 calls (+89% vs June), 15 first-time callers, and a 71% answer rate, up from 67% but still short of the 85% target. Site traffic nearly doubled month-over-month (+93%) but most of the increase is Display and unmeasured channels: Display spent $2,682 on 1.33M impressions for one tracked conversion, Microsoft/Bing grew to 916 sessions with no cost data, and a new WSJ summer-ads channel appeared at 474 sessions. The pipeline rebuilt — the warm bench rose from 19 to 24 with 12 new named prospects in July, 8 sales visits or meetings, and 2 reservations holding.

budget_roi.mtd_reconciliation_note: The Jul 16–30 fortnight report estimated ~112 leads / $27.3K spend for July month-to-date; the full-month extraction reads 107 leads / $21.1K. Ad-platform data revisions and differing lead definitions (Meta KPI leads vs website leads) account for the gap; the full-month figures here are authoritative for July.

vs_2026-07-27.period_note: Both periods are 30 days, but they overlap by 27 days — deltas are heavily damped and mostly confirm stability. Month-over-month movement vs June is quoted from dashboard-native deltas in the website/organic and phone sections.

google_conv_rate.interpretation: blended incl. Display; search-only rose 1.42% → 1.48%, best of year

recommendations.headline: Cap and geo-tighten Display before August
recommendations.detail: Display spent $2,682 on 1.33 million impressions for one tracked conversion, and it is the main reason site users nearly doubled month-over-month with no gain in pages per user. Top click geographies remain New York, San Jose and Chicago rather than Sarasota or genuine feeder markets. Tighten geo and placements, cap the budget, and judge it on form fills.

recommendations.headline: Phone coverage improved but is still below target
recommendations.detail: The answer rate rose from 67% to 71% while call volume jumped 89% — 17 calls, 15 of them first-time callers. But 5 calls still went unanswered, including every Print Ad and Google Organic call. The fortnight ending Jul 30 showed 88% is achievable; hold the backup ring group and voicemail ownership so the full-month number reaches the 85% target in August.

recommendations.headline: Rebalance Meta toward Brochure Download
recommendations.detail: Brochure Download delivered 26 leads at $54 — the cheapest volume in the account — while Feeder Market Segmented absorbed $4,985 (55% of Meta spend) at $217 per lead. Moving a quarter of the Feeder budget to Brochure Download and Sarasota prospecting buys roughly 20 additional leads at current rates.

recommendations.headline: Microsoft/Bing is growing and still invisible
recommendations.detail: Microsoft paid search grew to 916 sessions in July (820 non-branded, 96 branded) plus one CallRail 'Bing Ads' call — up from 796 in the prior window — and there is still no Microsoft cost or conversion data in the dashboard. Until the source is added, July's true blended cost per lead is understated.

recommendations.headline: New WSJ summer-ads channel appeared — confirm tracking
recommendations.detail: A digital/wsj_summer_ads source delivered 474 sessions this month, alongside mansionglobal.com and observer web banner referrals. Confirm what was purchased, whether it carries cost data, and give it UTM-consistent tagging so print/digital sponsorships can be judged next to paid search and social.

recommendations.headline: Decide on Competitors: 1.5 conversions for $2,786
recommendations.detail: The Competitors campaign ran at roughly $1,857 per lead against a blended $197. Either trim it to a small brand-defense budget or move the money to Non-Brand Sarasota ($329 per lead, 18.5 conversions) and Branded Search ($54 per lead).

recommendations.headline: Work the rebuilt warm bench — 24 warm, 12 new in July
recommendations.detail: The warm bench recovered from 19 to 24 with five agent-status prospects added in late July (Tomasa Fahey, Cathi Cooper, Jonathan Garcia, Santos Lou Rodriguez, Gail Trippi). William Tremko has favorite units picked (1404, 1504, 1206) and wants a showroom visit; Judith Tribble completed a Zoom presentation; Fanny Lange is shopping the $5–7M range with an Aug/Sep visit in play. Sales visits/meetings doubled to 8 — convert them while interest is live.
